snippet.title: The Need to Live Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A manor in the countryside stands resolute against the elements, protecting its occupants rain or shine.

Henri and Julien, its vampiric occupants, aren't weathering so well, however.

Centuries of life has left one numb and the other with crushing guilt.

When Adeline arrives mysteriously on their front step, it's up to her to find a middle ground while navigating her own set of challenges.
--
Route Guide is now Available!
https://chasecubed.itch.io/the-need-to-live/devlog/689906/route-guide-is-up
--
Game Content Warnings:

- Themes include discussions and descriptions of mental health conditions such as: PTSD, Suicidal Ideation, Depression, and Anxiety
- Imagery of blood, and fantasy violence
- Descriptions of blood, fantasy violence, trauma and suggestive scenes
--
